app.name: AnimaBooter
drop.title: Drop a disk image here
drop.subtitle: or click to browse — .iso, .img, .gz, .xz, .zst, .bz2
drop.invalid: That file is not a readable disk image.
drop.windowsIso.title: Windows ISO detected
drop.windowsIso.body: Windows ISOs may not boot via dd if install.wim is larger than 4 GiB. Continue at your own risk.
drop.unsupportedHint: zip archives are not supported — use the raw .img or a gz/xz/zst/bz2 stream.
drives.title: Select a target drive
drives.emptyHint: Plug in a USB stick or SD card and refresh.
confirm.title: This will erase the drive
confirm.subtitle: Everything on the target below will be permanently destroyed.
confirm.holdHint: Hold the button for 1.2s — it refuses to fire on a misclick.
confirm.systemWarn: This drive is flagged as SYSTEM. The backend will hard-refuse if it hosts the operating system.
progress.finalizingHint: Physically writing to the device — this can take a few minutes. Do not unplug the drive.
progress.cancel.title: Cancel this flash?
progress.cancel.body: The device will be left in an unknown state. You must re-flash it before using the drive.
error.title: Flash failed
error.cancelled.title: Flash cancelled
result.title: Your drive is ready
settings.unsafe.title: Enable unsafe mode?
settings.unsafe.body1: Internal disks will appear in the drive list. Writing to the wrong one can destroy your operating system.
settings.unsafe.body2: Last chance: internal disks are only one misclick away. The app will still hard-refuse drives that host the OS, but other internal data is fair game.
settings.title: Settings
help.title: Help
help.how.title: How it works
help.how.image: Choose a compatible disk image (.iso, .img, or a compressed image).
help.how.drive: Select the destination USB drive or SD card.
help.how.flash: Confirm and hold the button to write; verification is enabled by default.
help.safety.title: Simple and safe
help.safety.body: The app works locally, with no accounts or telemetry. It only shows removable drives and asks for confirmation before erasing data.
